Office configuration, goals, department mapping and workplace tags are in [[business-insights.legacy.offices]], the current Workplace UI is in [[business-insights.workplace]], and the area hub is [[business-insights.legacy]].

locations-city-source.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, On the Discovered Locations list a ZIA location-based workplace takes its city from the ZIA location configuration, and when it is not specified Zscaler relies on a MaxMind lookup of the IP address.

quotes: The city is mapped from the ZIA location configuration from the ZIA Admin Portal for ZIA location-based workplaces. If the value is not specified, Zscaler relies on the MaxMind lookup to locate the city's IP address.

locations-formulas.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, On the Discovered Locations list, Attendance is visits divided by the possible assigned headcount, times 100, and Occupancy is visits divided by the workplace capacity, times 100.

quotes: Attendance: The attendance percentage for the workplace for the filtered timeframe. This is calculated by dividing the total number of visits to the workplace by the total number of possible assigned headcount for the workplace, then multiplying it by 100.

Occupancy: The occupancy percentage for the workplace for the filtered timeframe. This is calculated by dividing the total number of visits to the workplace by the total capacity of the workplace, then multiplying it by 100.

locations-columns.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Discovered Locations list includes Visits Per Day (average unique visits per day), Percent Mapped (share of locations, sub-locations and IP addresses mapped to the office) and Office Mappings, and locations can be ignored from analytics.

quotes: Visits Per Day: The average unique visits per day for the location.
Percent Mapped: The percentage of locations, sub-locations, and IP addresses mapped to the office from the limit.
Ignore the location from analytics.
Office Mappings: The office mapped for this location.

locations-unknown.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, A workplace with an undefined city, state or country is categorized as Unknown City, State or Country.

quotes: A workplace with an undefined city, state, or country is categorized as an Unknown City, State, or Country, respectively.

locations-error-icon.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Hovering over the Error icon next to a workplace name gives reasons such as incorrect office configuration, missing metadata, or an office configured less than 24 hours ago.

quotes: (e.g., the office is not configured correctly, metadata is not added, the office was configured less than 24 hours ago, etc.)
If you don't see data for the workplace, hover over the Error icon
next to the workplace name to see the reason

user-types-filter.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Selecting User Types does not filter data unless user types are defined for the organization in Business Insights, and enabling the feature requires contacting Zscaler Support.

quotes: Selecting User Types doesn't filter the data unless you have defined user types for your organization in Business Insights. To enable and use this feature, contact Zscaler Support.

time-range-aggregation.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Workplace Insights Time Range offers the last 7 days, a week, a month or 3 months, and data aggregation for the custom week, month or quarter might take some time to process.

quotes: Time Range: View workplace insights for the last 7 days, a week, a month, or 3 months, then choose the week, month, or 3 months from the right pane. The data aggregation for the custom week, month, or quarter might take some time to process.

weekends-five-day.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, By default Saturdays and Sundays are excluded from the Workplace Insights metrics, which are calculated considering a 5-day work week.

quotes: By default, Saturdays and Sundays are excluded from the metrics.
The metrics are calculated considering a 5-day work week.

department-filter.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, On Workplace Insights the department filter is available unless at least one department is mapped to a division, and departments come from the ZIA Admin Portal SCIM.

quotes: The department filter is available unless you have at least one department mapping to a division on the Department Mapping page.
The departments within your organization. This data is mapped from the ZIA Admin Portal SCIM. If the values are inaccurate, contact a ZIA admin.

insights-one-type.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Workplace Insights Overall Averages can show either configured offices or inferred locations at one time.

quotes: You can only view data for either the configured offices or inferred locations at one time.

insights-possible-capacity.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, On Workplace Insights, total possible capacity is the capacity of all selected offices multiplied by the official working days in the time frame (capacity 100 over 5 working days gives 500), and the page also compares occupancy against the previous period (MoM, WoW or QoQ).

quotes: The total possible capacity is determined by multiplying the capacity for all selected offices by the number of official working days within the time frame selected.
if your capacity is 100 and there are 5 official working days, the possible capacity is 500.
percentage increase or decrease in occupancy vs. the previous period of the same time (e.g., Month over Month (MoM), Week over Week (WoW), or Quarter over Quarter (QoQ))

insights-possible-headcount.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, On the Workplace Insights and Offices and Locations chart pages, total possible assigned headcount is likewise computed as the capacity of all selected offices multiplied by the official working days in the time frame, and on the Workplace Details page as the workplace capacity multiplied by the official working days.

quotes: The total possible assigned headcount is determined by multiplying the capacity for all selected offices by the number of official working days within the time frame selected.
The total possible assigned headcount is determined by multiplying the capacity for all selected offices by the number of official working days within the time frame selected.
The total possible assigned headcount is determined by multiplying the workplace capacity by the number of official working days within the time frame selected.

insights-inferred-estimated.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, On Workplace Insights, the data in the Overall Averages section filtered to inferred offices is estimated because the service lacks precise metadata, and Zscaler recommends configuring offices; updated office metadata appears in Workplace Insights after the daily service scan.

quotes: If you've filtered the data for inferred offices, the data in this section are estimated as the Business Insights service doesn't have precise metadata to provide accurate insight.
After you update office metadata, it is reflected in Workplace Insights after the daily service scan.
Zscaler recommends configuring offices (providing metadata) for inferred location-based workplaces to get accurate insights.

insights-top-cities.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Top Cities shows cities by number of employees and office-visit frequency in three bands: remote, up to 2 days a week and more than 2 days a week.

quotes: This section shows the top cities by the number of employees and the frequency of their office visits (remote, less than or equal to 2 days a week, more than 2 days a week).

insights-remote-density.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Remote User Density lists Potential Sites Opportunities, cities with the number and percentage of remote users where an office could be opened.

quotes: Switch between Geography and Remote User Density to view the following insights:
Potential Sites Opportunities: A list of cities with the number and percentage of remote users where you can consider opening an office.

map-missing-office.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, A configured office missing from the map lacks metadata, and city, state or province and country must be specified when configuring the office.

quotes: If you don't see a configured office on the map, metadata for that office is missing. Make sure you specify the city, state or province, and country information when configuring offices to locate the configured office on the map.

map-show-sublocations.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Show ZIA Sub-locations toggle shows ZIA sub-locations in the list and is available when filtering for inferred location-based workplaces.

quotes: Enable the Show ZIA Sub-locations toggle to view ZIA sub-locations in the list. This option is available when you filter the data for inferred location-based workplaces.

chart-day-of-week-formulas.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, In the Offices and Locations chart view, occupancy by day of the week is visits that day divided by possible capacity times 100, and attendance by day of the week is visits that day divided by possible assigned headcount times 100.

quotes: dividing the number of visits to the workplaces on that day by the possible capacity of the workplaces, then multiplying it by 100.
dividing the number of visits to the workplaces on that day by the total number of possible assigned headcount of the workplaces, then multiplying it by 100.

details-day-of-week-formulas.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, On the Workplace Details page, occupancy by day of the week is users who came into the workplace that day divided by capacity times 100, and attendance by day of the week is users who came that day divided by users assigned times 100.

quotes: dividing the number of users who came into the workplace on that day by the capacity of the workplace, then multiplying it by 100.
dividing the number of users who came to the workplace on that day by the total number of users assigned to the workplace, then multiplying it by 100.

details-footfall.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Footfall by the Time of the Day section shows hourly footfall averaged for 7 days of the week when monthly data is selected, and its CSV export is available when the Time Range is Last 7 days or Week.

quotes: This section shows the hourly footfall information for the workplace for the filtered time frame averaged for 7 days of the week if you select to view monthly data.
Click the Export button to download the footfall data as a CSV file. This option is available when the Time Range filter at the top of the page is selected as Last 7 days or Week.

details-days-per-week.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, On the Workplace Details page, Attendance by Days per Week is a pie chart of the percentage of users and their count who came to the workplace from less than a day to 7 days a week, and Attendance by Department can include unassigned users via Show Unassigned Users.

quotes: The pie chart shows the percentage of users (and their count) who came into the workplace less than a day to 7 days a week.
Select the Show Unassigned Users checkbox to view the data for users that are not assigned to a department.

possible-headcount-basis.summary: The Workplace Insights, chart and Workplace Details pages compute total possible assigned headcount from office capacity, while the terminology and office configuration articles define Assigned Headcount as the users assigned to an office.

quotes: The total possible assigned headcount is determined by multiplying the capacity for all selected offices by the number of official working days within the time frame selected.

positions.says: Total possible assigned headcount is the capacity of the selected offices times the official working days.

quotes: Assigned Headcount: The number of users assigned to an office.

positions.says: Assigned Headcount is the number of users assigned to an office.

quotes: Assigned Headcount: Enter the number of users that you want to assign to the office. This value helps calculate the attendance metrics for the office.

positions.says: Assigned Headcount is a number entered for the office, separate from Capacity, and helps calculate attendance.

possible-headcount-basis.impact: Whether the attendance denominator is built from capacity or from the assigned headcount entered for an office is not stated consistently.

attendance-by-day-basis.summary: The three pages that describe Attendance by Day of the Week count visits, users who came, or headcount differently, and only two of them multiply by 100.

quotes: This is calculated by dividing the number of visits to the workplaces on that day by the total number of possible assigned headcount of the workplaces, then multiplying it by 100.

positions.says: The chart page divides visits on that day by the total possible assigned headcount, times 100.

quotes: This is calculated by dividing the number of users who came to the workplace on that day by the total number of users assigned to the workplace, then multiplying it by 100.

positions.says: The Workplace Details page divides users who came that day by the users assigned, times 100.

quotes: This is calculated by dividing the number of visits to the workplace on that day by the total number of headcount assigned to the workplace.

positions.says: The Workplace Insights page divides visits on that day by the headcount assigned, with no multiplication by 100.

attendance-by-day-basis.impact: Whether the per-day attendance counts visits or distinct users, and whether the denominator is possible assigned headcount or assigned users, differs by page.
